verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against the Ammonites . . . and prophesy against them
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, olha para os filhos de Amom e profetiza contra eles.

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֡ה יַעַן֩ אָמְרֵ֨ךְ הֶאָ֜ח אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֣י כִֽי־ נִחָ֗ל וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּ֣י נָשַׁ֔מָּה וְאֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֥י הָלְכ֖וּ בַּגּוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā liḇ·nê ‘am·mō·wn šim·‘ū də·ḇar- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ā·mə·rêḵ he·’āḥ ’el- miq·dā·šî ḵî- ni·ḥāl wə·’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî nā·šam·māh wə·’el- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh kî hā·lə·ḵū bag·gō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Tell the Ammonites . . . to hear the word of the Lord GOD for this is what the Lord GOD says Because you exclaimed Aha when My sanctuary was profaned when the land of Israel was laid waste and when the house of Judah went into exile
verses.literalPt: Dize aos filhos de Amom: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor Jeová: Porquanto disseste: Ah! Contra o meu santuário quando foi profanado, e contra a terra de Israel quando foi desolada, e contra a casa de Judá, quando foram ao cativeiro,

verses.original: לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נֹתְנָ֨ךְ לִבְנֵי־ קֶ֜דֶם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֗ה וְיִשְּׁב֤וּ טִירֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְנָ֥תְנוּ בָ֖ךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הֵ֚מָּה יֹאכְל֣וּ פִרְיֵ֔ךְ וְהֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁתּ֥וּ חֲלָבֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî nō·ṯə·nāḵ liḇ·nê- qe·ḏem lə·mō·w·rā·šāh wə·yiš·šə·ḇū ṭî·rō·w·ṯê·hem bāḵ wə·nā·ṯə·nū ḇāḵ miš·kə·nê·hem hêm·māh yō·ḵə·lū p̄ir·yêḵ wə·hêm·māh yiš·tū ḥă·lā·ḇêḵ
verses.literal: therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you They will eat your fruit . . . and drink your milk
verses.literalPt: por isso eis que te entregarei aos filhos do Oriente para lhes seres uma possessão, e em ti estabelecerão os seus aduares, e porão em ti as suas moradas. Eles comerão os teus frutos e eles beberão o teu leite.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ רַבָּה֙ לִנְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְמִרְבַּץ־ צֹ֑אן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- rab·bāh lin·wêh ḡə·mal·lîm wə·’eṯ- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn lə·mir·baṣ- ṣōn wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and Ammon a resting place for sheep Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: De Rabá farei uma estrebaria de camelos e, dos filhos de Amom, um curral de rebanhos; e sabereis que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן מַחְאֲךָ֣ יָ֔ד וְרַקְעֲךָ֖ בְּרָ֑גֶל וַתִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּכָל־ שָֽׁאטְךָ֙ בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ אֶל־ אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an maḥ·’ă·ḵā yāḏ wə·raq·‘ă·ḵā bə·rā·ḡel wat·tiś·maḥ bə·ḵāl šā·ṭə·ḵā bə·ne·p̄eš ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Because you clapped your hands and stomped your feet and rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of contempt
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porque aplaudiste com as mãos, e bateste com os pés, e, com todo o despeito do teu coração, te alegraste contra a terra de Israel,

verses.original: לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֤יךָֽ־ לְבַג לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךָ מִן־ הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî nā·ṭî·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā- lə·ḇaḡ lag·gō·w·yim wə·hiḵ·rat·tî·ḵā min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā min- hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’aš·mî·ḏə·ḵā wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: therefore I will indeed stretch out My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations I will cut you off from the peoples and exterminate you from the countries I will destroy you and you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: portanto eis que estendi a minha mão contra ti e te darei por despojo às nações; exterminar-te-ei dentre os povos e te farei perecer dentre os países; destruir-te-ei, e saberás que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֗עַן אֲמֹ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ וְשֵׂעִ֔יר הִנֵּ֥ה כְּכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ă·mōr mō·w·’āḇ wə·śê·‘îr hin·nêh kə·ḵāl- hag·gō·w·yim bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because Moab and Seir said Look the house of Judah is like all the other nations
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto dizem Moabe e Seir: Eis que a casa de Judá é como todas as nações;

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ הִנְנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־ כֶּ֤תֶף מוֹאָב֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים מֵֽעָרָ֖יו מִקָּצֵ֑הוּ צְבִ֗י אֶ֚רֶץ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁימֹ֔ת בַּ֥עַל מְע֖וֹן וְקִרְיָתְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî p̄ō·ṯê·aḥ ’eṯ- ke·ṯep̄ mō·w·’āḇ mê·he·‘ā·rîm mê·‘ā·rāw miq·qā·ṣê·hū ṣə·ḇî ’e·reṣ bêṯ hay·šî·mōṯ ba·‘al mə·‘ō·wn wə·qir·yå̄·ṯə·må̄h
verses.literal: therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities . . . Beth-jeshimoth Baal-meon and Kiriathaim the glory of the land
verses.literalPt: portanto eis que abrirei o lado de Moabe desde as cidades, sim, desde as suas cidades que estão pela banda das suas fronteiras, a glória do país, Bete-Jesimote, Baal-Meom e Quiriataim;

verses.original: לִבְנֵי־ קֶ֙דֶם֙ עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּנְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן לֹֽא־ תִזָּכֵ֥ר בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê- qe·ḏem ‘al- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hā lə·mō·w·rā·šāh lə·ma·‘an lō- ṯiz·zā·ḵêr bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: I will give it along with the Ammonites as a possession to the people of the East so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations
verses.literalPt: abri-lo-ei aos filhos do Oriente para irem contra os filhos de Amom e destes farei uma possessão, para que não haja mais memória dos filhos de Amom entre as nações.

verses.original: וּבְמוֹאָ֖ב אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה שְׁפָטִ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.literal: So I will execute judgments on Moab and they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também executarei juízos sobre Moabe, e saberão que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֱד֛וֹם בִּנְקֹ֥ם נָקָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֶּאְשְׁמ֥וּ אָשׁ֖וֹם וְנִקְּמ֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm bin·qōm nā·qām lə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh way·ye’·šə·mū ’ā·šō·wm wə·niq·qə·mū ḇā·hem
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because Edom acted vengefully . . . against the house of Judah and in so doing . . . incurred grievous guilt . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto Edom se houve vingativamente contra a casa de Judá, e cometeu graves ofensas, e se vingou deles,

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְנָטִ֤תִי יָדִי֙ עַל־ אֱד֔וֹם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֣ם וּבְהֵמָ֑ה וּנְתַתִּ֤יהָ חָרְבָּה֙ מִתֵּימָ֔ן וּדְדָ֖נֶה בַּחֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·nā·ṭi·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hā ḥā·rə·bāh mit·tê·mān ū·ḏə·ḏā·neh ba·ḥe·reḇ yip·pō·lū
verses.literal: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast I will make it a wasteland and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword
verses.literalPt: portanto assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Estenderei a minha mão sobre Edom e dele exterminarei homens e animais; fá-lo-ei desolado desde Temã, e até Dedã cairão pela espada.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֜י בֶּאֱד֗וֹם בְּיַד֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעָשׂ֣וּ בֶאֱד֔וֹם כְּאַפִּ֖י וְכַחֲמָתִ֑י וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯî be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm bə·yaḏ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘ā·śū ḇe·’ĕ·ḏō·wm kə·’ap·pî wə·ḵa·ḥă·mā·ṯî wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will take My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and wrath Then they will know My vengeance declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Porei a minha vingança sobre Edom pela mão do meu povo de Israel; farão em Edom segundo a minha ira e segundo o meu furor; e conhecerão a minha vingança, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן עֲשׂ֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בִּנְקָמָ֑ה וַיִּנָּקְמ֤וּ נָקָם֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַשְׁחִ֖ית אֵיבַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ‘ă·śō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm bin·qā·māh way·yin·nā·qə·mū nā·qām biš·’āṭ bə·ne·p̄eš lə·maš·ḥîṯ ’ê·ḇaṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because the Philistines acted in vengeance taking vengeance with malice of soul to destroy Judah with ancient hostility
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porquanto os filisteus se houveram vingativamente e executaram vingança com despeito de alma, para destruírem com perpétua inimizade;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י נוֹטֶ֤ה יָדִי֙ עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת־ כְּרֵתִ֑ים וְהַ֣אֲבַדְתִּ֔י אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית ח֥וֹף הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî nō·w·ṭeh yā·ḏî ‘al- pə·liš·tîm wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’eṯ- kə·rê·ṯîm wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî ’eṯ- šə·’ê·rîṯ ḥō·wp̄ hay·yām
verses.literal: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast
verses.literalPt: portanto assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Eis que estenderei a minha mão sobre os filisteus, e exterminarei os quereteus, e destruirei as relíquias da costa do mar.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתִי בָם֙ נְקָמ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת בְּתוֹכְח֖וֹת חֵמָ֑ה וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֥י אֶת־ נִקְמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî ḇām nə·qā·mō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḥō·wṯ ḥê·māh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·ṯit·tî ’eṯ- niq·mā·ṯî bām
verses.literal: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof Then they will know that I am the LORD when I lay My vengeance upon them
verses.literalPt: Deles tomarei grandes vinganças com furiosas repreensões; saberão que eu sou Jeová, quando eu tiver exercitado a minha vingança sobre eles.
